About China Sourcing Co

Our mission is to connect you with the best factories in Asia, ensuring you get the highest quality products at the best possible prices.

Our Journey

From Vision to Impact

2020: Where It All Started
2021: Building the Foundation
2022: Growing With Our Clients
2023: Going Global
2024: Scaling With Purpose
2025: And This Is Just the Beginning

2020: Where It All Started

After a decade of hands-on experience across China and Asia, Tom and Sam launched OneLink to provide importers with a reliable, on the ground supply chain partner they can trust.

2021: Building the Foundation

We built a vetted factory network across China and Vietnam, formalized our QA playbook, and hired core team members across sourcing, production, quality control and freight.

2022: Growing With Our Clients

The addition of new brands across industries, including hotel furniture and packaging, led to a doubling in order volume, validating our model's ability to scale while maintaining full operational control.

2023: Going Global

With the launch of our Australia office, clients now benefit from 24 hour coverage and seamless multi country sourcing across APAC, Australia, and the U.S.

2024: Scaling With Purpose

As of 2024, OneLink has a growing team of 21 members operating across Asia, America, Australia, and Europe.

2025: And This Is Just the Beginning

To better connect with global buyers and address their sourcing needs, we rebranded as China Sourcing Co, a name that underscores our deep expertise and strong capabilities with sourcing in China.
From Our Founder

Sam Sheehan

Director

We started China Sourcing Co after years of working within product-based businesses across various industries. Throughout that journey, we encountered the same recurring challenges gaps in communication, lack of transparency, delayed timelines, and a general disconnect between vision and execution.

 

We knew there had to be a better way, one that offered clarity, speed, and a true sense of partnership from idea to shelf. China Sourcing Co was built to be that better way.

Our Process

How We Quality Control

Factory audit
Pre production inspection (PPI)
During production inspection (DUPRO)
Pre shipment inspection (PSI)
Container loading check (CLC)
Step 1

Factory audit

A factory audit is a thorough evaluation of a manufacturing facility to assess its capabilities, processes, and adherence to quality standards. The purpose of a factory audit is to ensure that a supplier or manufacturer meets the specified requirements and standards set by the client.

Step 2

Pre production inspection (PPI)

The purpose of a PPI check is to assess the initial stages of production to ensure that the production processes are set up correctly, materials meet specifications, and potential issues are identified and addressed early.

Step 3

During production inspection (DUPRO)

A DUPRO is a quality control measure conducted at various stages of the manufacturing process to assess the ongoing production and identify and rectify any potential issues in real-time. This inspection is crucial for ensuring that the production is progressing according to the approved specifications, quality standards, and client requirements.

Step 4

Pre shipment inspection (PSI)

The primary purpose of a pre-shipment inspection is to verify that the finished products meet the required quality standards, specifications, and contractual agreements before they are shipped to the client.

Step 5

Container loading check (CLC)

A CLC is a quality control measure conducted at the final stage of the shipping process, specifically when goods are being loaded into shipping containers for transport. The primary objective of a container loading check is to ensure that the products are correctly and securely loaded into the containers to prevent damage during transit and to verify that the correct quantity of goods is being shipped.
